description: test_chunking_splits_long_text_into_multiple_chunks is split into two set-parametrized steps sharing module state
find:
def test_chunking_splits_long_text_into_multiple_chunks() -> None:
    text = "Cloud computing is a model for delivering resources. " * 20
    chunks = _service().chunk(uuid4(), text)
    assert len(chunks) > 1
notes: test order dependency: the [count] case reads module-level state written by the [split] case. Both come from parametrizing over a set, whose string iteration order changes with per-process hash randomization, so in ~50% of processes [count] runs first and fails with KeyError. The failing node id carries the [count] parameter suffix.
